messages.subject: Project Drake — Term Sheet for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Aisha,

Attached is the agreed Term Sheet reflecting the headline economics (pre-money £24m, £8m investment, £8.00/share, 25% post-money to the investors) and the key protections. The binding clauses (exclusivity to 15 November, costs, confidentiality, governing law) are flagged.

If you're happy, please sign and return; Calderbrook will counter-sign. Then we move to diligence.

Best,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
